title: Certify the 144 symmetries of the SL3 LR chamber rays

source.citation: Emmanuel Briand and Mercedes Rosas, The 144 symmetries of the Littlewood-Richardson coefficients of SL3, arXiv:2004.04995

translation.notes: The notebook's nine rays and four generators are retained. Exact rational linear algebra constructs their Gram projector; every one of the 144 group elements preserves it, and the first listed chamber has the expected orbit of size 18.
